body.message: Hi fäm Living team, Im Harish from Locqora. I came across your business on Google and saw 4.7 rating and 1,137 reviews. For holiday homes, direct bookings depend heavily on trust, photos, reviews, and a frictionless WhatsApp/booking path. I noticed you already have a website, so the opportunity may be improving the journey from search to inquiry/booking. Can I share a quick free audit on how you could improve direct booking enquiries?
